boundaries.controls_integrity: Only the three frozen adapter/reader/readback controls were reread after validation.
boundaries.elf: The frozen copied CLI was hashed by the existing adapter; no additional internal Cargo out-dir ELF digest was performed.
boundaries.postflight: The adapter does not independently parse postflight cleanup semantics; cleanup provenance remains the fixed handoff, original postflight evidence, and independent review.
boundaries.source_integrity: Each of the 213 source blobs was checked within its individual read using metadata identity and hashes; there was no second whole-source pass and no continuous whole-tree immutability claim.
